items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Like, I think a great example is Birch Johnson in our band

ctx.x: -- New England Conservatory. If you're a brass player particularly, you should consider going to Eastman, if you can get in.

But then, we have so many great music departments in state universities all over this country, that really, you're not limited. It just depends on where you want to finish up. Like, I think a great example is Birch Johnson in our band, who got his degree at the University of Alabama, and then went to Eastman and got his master's. That I think is a wise decision.
And it didn't take that long, nor was it that difficult, because he had the ability and he had the training. It was just a question of improving it.
